definitions.gloss: cold wind; bitter wind; icy wind
definitions.explanation: A harsh, cold wind, especially one that blows in winter. A somewhat literary or formal word that conveys the biting severity of the cold.

examples.japanese: {寒風|かんぷう}が{吹|ふ}きすさぶ。
{寒風|かんぷう}の{中|なか}、{行列|ぎょうれつ}に{並|なら}んだ。
examples.english: I stood in line in the bitter wind.

examples.japanese: {寒風|かんぷう}{吹|ふ}きすさぶ{冬|ふゆ}の{海岸|かいがん}を{一人|ひとり}で{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: I walked alone along the winter coast where bitter winds were blowing.

notes:
A literary/formal word for a harsh cold wind. More evocative and literary than simply {冷|つめ}たい{風|かぜ} (cold wind). Often used in descriptive writing and news reports about winter weather.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寒風|かんぷう}が{吹|ふ}く: a cold wind blows
- {寒風|かんぷう}が{吹|ふ}きすさぶ: bitter wind howls
- {寒風|かんぷう}にさらされる: to be exposed to the bitter wind
- {寒風|かんぷう}の{中|なか}: in the bitter cold wind

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {北風|きたかぜ}: north wind — specifies direction; not necessarily literary
- {木枯|こが}らし: cold wintry wind — specifically the first cold wind of late autumn/early winter
- {烈風|れっぷう}: fierce wind — emphasizes violence of the wind, not necessarily cold

FORMS:
{寒|かん} (cold) + {風|ぷう} (wind)
